v.title: Bellingham’s Brilliance Turns Madrid’s Match into a Masterclass
v.excerpt: Bellingham’s bench heroics give real madrid a 3‑2 comeback win over PSV, preserving their Champions League perfect record.
v.body:
## Quick take
Jude Bellingham’s late strike from the bench sealed a 3‑2 win for real madrid over PSV, keeping the Spanish giants undefeated in the Champions League.

## What happened
In the first half, PSV struck early, exploiting a lapse in real madrid’s defence to take a 1‑0 lead. Real madrid’s midfield struggled to regain rhythm, and the Spanish side seemed to be playing a defensive game. The turning point came in the 73rd minute when real madrid substituted Bellingham for a fresh spark. The 21‑year‑old burst down the right flank, cut inside, and curled a left‑footed shot past the PSV keeper, levelising the score.

The momentum swung dramatically. Real madrid’s forwards pressed high, forcing PSV into hurried counter‑attacks. In the 84th minute, a perfectly weighted through ball found Bellingham again, who tapped in a header to make it 2‑1. Real madrid’s defence held firm as the match neared its end, and the team celebrated a flawless 100% record in the group stage.

## Why it matters
- **Bellingham’s impact**: The young midfielder’s two goals in the second half demonstrate his growing influence in high‑stakes games, signalling that he could become a central figure in real madrid’s attacking arsenal for the rest of the season.
- **Barcelona’s caution**: As Barca chase a Champions League spot, Madrid’s ability to turn deficits into victories underscores the importance of resilience and depth—qualities Barça must emulate if they hope to compete on both fronts.
- **Seasonal implications**: With real madrid maintaining an unblemished record, the pressure on the Spanish side to sustain form mounts. Any slip could jeopardise their qualification for the knockout stage, a scenario that could ripple across the league standings.

## What's next
Real madrid will face a tough test against a top‑tier opponent in the upcoming group match. Watch how Bellingham’s role evolves—will he continue as a substitute spark or cement a starting spot? For Barça, the focus should shift to tightening the midfield to counter Madrid’s counter‑attacking threat, especially when they play from a high defensive line. The next fixture will reveal whether real madrid can keep their perfect streak alive or if the pressure will finally bite.

*Source: [Real Madrid put in five-star second half to win against PSV](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/c5evr0y83197o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)*
